results: Empty submit invokes native required-field validation and keeps focus in QR input

narrowHeaderFinding.before: At 320px, logout width shrank to 23.1px and overlapped the Soát vé label
narrowHeaderFinding.fix: Two-row narrow header grid, non-shrinking 33px account/logout targets and non-wrapping 40px navigation targets
narrowHeaderFinding.observed: Header targets no longer overlap; input, submit and duplicate-result text remain visible

limitations: These are specific UI observations, not a completed 90-row checklist.
Actual screen-reader speech, real mobile touch exploration, full workflow keyboard review and real browser zoom remain unverified.
DOM role=alert observation is not evidence that a screen reader announced the error.
